hook.text: How many piano tuners are in Chicago? Enrico Fermi could estimate it in minutes with no data.

buildup.text: Fermi estimation breaks an impossible question into smaller guessable pieces: households, piano ownership.

discovery.text: Multiply rough estimates together and the errors cancel out.

twist.text: Google and McKinsey use Fermi problems in interviews.

climax.text: Practice Fermi estimation on any question.

punchline.text: No data? No problem. Decompose and estimate.

quiz.question: Why do Fermi estimations work despite rough guesses?
options: Overestimates and underestimates tend to cancel each other out
